register_objects365_coco_instances: import this module to register objects365_train and objects365_val COCO dataset splits with detectron2
get_builtin_metadata_v1: call _get_builtin_metadata('v1') to get the 365 class IDs and contiguous ID mapping for Objects365 v1
use_categories_v1: access categories_v1 list to get all 365 object category IDs and names for the Objects365 dataset
use_predefined_splits: access _PREDEFINED_SPLITS_OBJECTS365 dict to get train and val image root and annotation JSON paths
register_custom_objects365_split: use register_coco_instances with a custom key and _get_builtin_metadata('v1') to register a new Objects365 split
